note: Test fixture, not a cut. test/tooling/execute-diamond-cut.output.test.ts runs the executor against this file on a local chain, to prove it prints a record line for everything it deploys - a facet and the initializer alike, those lines being all the recorder ever sees - and that it writes no deployment record itself. The facet list and the initializer are deliberately unalike so the two print sites cannot cover for each other. It can never execute.
